insights: Extreme vertical rhythm: sections are separated by 10rem (160px) on desktop, creating a slow, deliberate scroll experience that emphasizes breathing room and focus.
Asymmetric grid usage: Hero uses a 7/5 split, Mission Statement uses 4/8, but Latest Releases uses a strict 3-column equal grid – variety within a 12-column system.
Typography hierarchy is soft: large display serif headlines (Anthropic Serif) anchor sections, but body text is generous (1.25rem / 20px base, 1.4 line-height) and inviting, never cramped.
The Feature Banner employs a scroll-driven animation (manatee video fades out, WebGL sky fades in) that transforms the hero as the user scrolls – a sophisticated layering technique for storytelling.

Color palette is minimal and warm: cream/beige backgrounds, black text, accent orange (#d97757) for CTAs, dark footer – no gradients or heavy color blocking, allowing photography and whitespace to carry visual interest.
